name: Gradebook
state_flow: Draft → reviewed → released → correction requested
critical_tests: Student cannot read draft; TA cannot release; projection cannot overwrite actual

name: Degree audit
state_flow: Evidence loaded → evaluated → exception review → accepted snapshot
critical_tests: Unknown evidence is not satisfied; what-if cannot update official audit

name: Transcripts
state_flow: Requested → validated → generated → released → delivered
critical_tests: Draft excluded; delivery retry not duplicate request

name: Admissions · PROP-WF-016
state_flow: Prospect → application draft → submitted → review → decision released → matriculation handoff
critical_tests: Applicant cannot read internal review; submit does not imply admit

name: Campus services
authority: Separate housing, dining, maintenance, and finance owners
state_flow: Request → allocation → contract → charge → entitlement → move-in → service
critical_tests: Last bed has one winner; replay redemption debits once

name: Community and clubs
state_flow: Draft → published → reported → review → action → appeal
critical_tests: Private group not indexed publicly; report does not publish identity

name: Campus marketplace
authority: Listing owner; governed reservation and moderation services
state_flow: Draft → verified → live → reserved → pickup confirmed → completed
critical_tests: One active reservation; institutional affiliation not safety guarantee

name: Company site and marketing
state_flow: Draft → review → published → identity handoff
critical_tests: No private education records in acquisition analytics

name: Institution console
state_flow: Configure → validate → approve → activate → monitor
critical_tests: Institution admin is not unrestricted student-record reader

name: Course Studio
authority: Course author and delegated teaching team
state_flow: Draft → accessibility review → approved → published → archived
critical_tests: TA scope bounded; question bank not leaked to student

name: Course workspace · ECON 1020 / BUS 1400
authority: Course publication authority; learner personal artifacts
state_flow: Published item → saved working set → study → reflection
critical_tests: Today and course share canonical item ID; course content remains fixtures unless sourced

name: Device capabilities
state_flow: Not asked → pre-prompt → OS decision → available or declined → revoked
critical_tests: Decline offers fallback; server preference cannot claim OS grant

name: External audiences
state_flow: Invite → verify → grant scope → use → expire or revoke
critical_tests: Verified identity does not imply educational-record access

name: Faculty grading workspace
state_flow: Rubric draft → suggestions reviewed → submitted → approved → released
critical_tests: AI suggestions stay draft; accommodation instructions omit unrelated sensitive detail

name: Student mobile
state_flow: Today → My Path → Search → Plan → Me
critical_tests: Phone layout does not expand permissions

name: Careers and employers
authority: Student sharing choice and career/employer scope
state_flow: Profile choice → opportunity → application → employer review → outcome
critical_tests: Employer sees submitted scope, not grades by default

name: Alumni mentoring
state_flow: Opt in → match → accept → interact → close or revoke
critical_tests: Matching does not reveal academic records

name: Family and guardian access
authority: Verified delegation and applicable institutional rules
state_flow: Invite → accept → scoped grant → view → expire or revoke
critical_tests: Revoke blocks subsequent access; guardian role alone grants nothing

name: Registrar readiness pilot
authority: Owning offices confirm facts; registrar coordinates readiness
state_flow: Unknown → evidence checked → ready as of or blocked/review/stale/handoff
critical_tests: One released hold does not imply ready; missing prerequisite unknown

name: Registrar replacement blueprint
authority: One configured writer per authoritative domain
state_flow: Propose → validate → approve → commit → project → reconcile
critical_tests: Last seat one winner; authority switch requires approved cutover

name: Semester Account and Mail
authority: Identity authority; separate mailbox and institution owners
state_flow: Sign up → verify → recoverable account → link institution → optional mailbox
critical_tests: Username is not mailbox entitlement; account link not role grant

name: Student Affairs / Advisor slice
state_flow: Intake → triage → assigned → referral accepted → support → resolved
critical_tests: Note classes separated; referral discloses only approved fields

name: Study Studio
authority: Source owner and authorized artifact creator
state_flow: Choose sources → choose format → generate draft → review → save/share
critical_tests: No unauthorized source retrieval; regeneration preserves edits

name: Semester platform and staff shell
state_flow: Enter → validate grant → select workspace → first action
critical_tests: Role switch clears forbidden cache and late responses

name: Student lifecycle
state_flow: Admission → affiliation → enrollment → progression → completion → alumni
critical_tests: Student lifecycle does not collapse into one status field

name: Master catalog and screen atlas
state_flow: Specified → rendered → behavioral → integrated → permission tested → verified
critical_tests: Rendered thumbnail is not implementation evidence

name: Design system and trust components
state_flow: Specify → implement → test → adopt → version
critical_tests: Every state named; missing numbers not zero; source and authority visible
